unit.why: A single narrative, quoted from the book Ramatz, about the Rebbe of Peshischa's lavish charity to the poor hasid R. Zalman of Shefs, ending with the Rebbe's explanation of the verse on giving.

stories.end_quote: הנמצא איש כזה אשר רוח אלקי׳ בקרבו
stories.summary_en: On his way home from Danzig the Rebbe of Peshischa stops in Shefs. He gives the poor hasid R. Zalman money for a festive meal and clothes him and his whole family. At parting he gives him still more money and explains that only once pity is gone can one fulfil the commandment of charity properly.
